title: Upgraded NYPS 2.0 is open to all the educational institutions, groups and citizens across the country
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs

Upgraded NYPS 2.0 is open to all the educational institutions, groups and citizens across the country

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
22 JUL 2026 4:32PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs has launched an upgraded version of the National Youth Parliament Scheme (NYPS) web portal, known as NYPS 2.0 on 11
th
 September 2024. Unlike the previous version, which was limited to students of recognized institutions only, NYPS 2.0 is open to all the educational institutions, groups and citizens across the country. Since its launch the details of institutional, group and individual registrations recorded on the portal are as follows (Constituency-wise data is not maintained on the portal) –
